description: This Dart file defines the TransactionsScreen widget for a Flutter application. It manages the display of a list of financial transactions, including features like filtering by date and type (income/expense), swipe-to-edit/delete functionality, and integration with state management via Provider. The file contains UI components, asynchronous data fetching for category metadata, and navigation logic for editing and adding transactions.

classes.name: TransactionsScreen
classes.description: Main widget screen displaying list of transactions with filtering and actions.

classes.name: _TransactionsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing internal state and UI logic for TransactionsScreen.

classes.name: _FilterBar
classes.description: Stateless widget providing filtering controls for transaction type and date range.

classes.name: _KindSegmented
classes.description: Stateful widget providing segmented control for transaction type filter (All, Income, Expense).

classes.name: _DateQuickChips
classes.description: Stateless widget providing quick filter chips for date ranges.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Initial load trigger for fetching recent transactions when dependencies change.

methods.name: _applyDateFilter
methods.description: Updates the date filter state and sets the corresponding date range in the provider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the transactions list screen, including app bar, filters, and transaction list.

methods.name: _dismissBg
methods.description: Helper method returning background widget for swipe-to-edit/delete actions.
